subject: Brain imaging reveals how an information hub integrates signals during decision-making
script: From Agewell Brief: Brain imaging reveals how an information hub integrates signals during decision-making. New imaging data show how a central hub synchronizes memory, motor, and sensory streams—echoing Hebb's plasticity and Llinás's oscillatory binding. Every decision—whether merging into traffic or choosing a word—demands that your brain weave together memory, motor plans, and live sensory input. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
